up: Retrieve all distinct molecules (compounds) that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728528. For each molecule, provide the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), its preferred name (pref_name) from the molecule_dictionary table, and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) from the compound_structures table. The document ID should be obtained from the docs table using the given ChEMBL ID, then join compound_records on doc_id, and then join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Use a LEFT JOIN to compound_structures to include SMILES when available. Return only distinct molecules, with no additional filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728528';
